Class VulkanDescriptorSetManager

java.lang.Object
icyllis.arc3d.core.RefCnt
icyllis.arc3d.vulkan.VulkanDescriptorSetManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
RefCounted
public final class VulkanDescriptorSetManager extends RefCnt
Manages descriptor sets for a single VulkanDescriptorSetLayout, actually a descriptor pool manager. Our descriptor set grouping strategy is based on update frequency, so each set has its own manager.

Persistable descriptor sets and dynamic descriptor sets are both allowed. Whether persisting is enabled is determined at creation time.
